subject: HIT-105

materialized_result.summary: Добавлено обязательное подтверждение email кодом в Keycloak 26.8.1. Регистрация и одноразовое подтверждение через реальное SMTP-письмо прошли на отдельном тестовом realm с PostgreSQL 18.7.

verification.environment: Ubuntu 24.04.5 amd64, отдельная VM; Keycloak 26.8.1, OpenJDK 21.0.12.1, PostgreSQL 18.7, Mailpit 1.33.1 и Chromium 159 под Playwright 1.65.1.

commands.result: exit 0; 15 браузерных и интеграционных сценариев прошли

checked_behavior: public registration, genuine SMTP, keyboard submit and one-time verification
five wrong codes lock the challenge; the real code cannot unlock it
expired challenge and unknown key version fail closed without consuming a code
resend enforces cooldown and rolling cap; changing generation invalidates the older code
a second browser flow keeps the rate limit and cannot use the first flow code
a changed Keycloak email invalidates the outstanding code
two parallel resends yield one replacement and one actual SMTP message
two parallel submits yield exactly one authorization and one database consumption
an actual database rollback leaves both verification markers unset
actual SMTP 451 leaves the account unverified and retains cooldown
SMTP greeting timeout cannot hold the rate and challenge row locks
deleting an IdP user removes their challenge
restart after database issuance and before SMTP preserves cooldown and permits a later resend
rotating the actual Keycloak code key invalidates version 1 and preserves recipient limits
scheduled cleanup purges only expired challenge and recipient history
verification.sandbox_cleanup: No named lab containers, volumes, network or loopback listeners remained

limitations: Стенд использует локальный SMTP-приёмник и временный IdP.
Выдача сессии HitPipe, рабочий OIDC callback, BFF и внешняя доставка почты относятся к отдельным задачам.
